questions.prompt: Oxygen has the electron arrangement 2, 6. What is its valency?

questions.prompt: How many protons and electrons does a chloride ion, Cl⁻, have?

questions.prompt: Why does carbon usually share electrons rather than form ions?
options: It has 4 outer electrons, so losing or gaining 4 would take too much energy
It has a full outer shell
questions.explain: Carbon has valency 4 and forms covalent bonds by sharing.

questions.prompt: Match each element to its valency.
Explain why sodium and chlorine atoms react, and describe what happens to their electrons.
questions.modelAnswer: Sodium has one outer electron (2, 8, 1) and chlorine has seven (2, 8, 7). Neither has a full outer shell. Sodium loses its outer electron to become Na⁺ (2, 8) and chlorine gains it to become Cl⁻ (2, 8, 8). Both now have full outer shells like noble gases, and the oppositely charged ions attract to form sodium chloride.
rubric: Neither has a full outer shell
